pr_body:
Add support for adding and removing streams to a non-started unicast group. 

Also fixes some check in the `bt_audio_unicast_group_delete` function. 

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41196
pr_comments: This is blocking https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/42587 so please review :)

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Reconfigure Unicast Group after creation
issue_context.body: As a developer I want to reconfigure my bt_audio_unicast_group after creating, such as changing the codec, QoS or adding more audio channels.

review_comments: `BT_ISO_CIG_STATE_IDLE` is only used for CIGs that have been been created. Once a CIG is created, it goes into the CONFIGURED state.
The ISO APIs takes arrays of pointers to allow for a more flexible API, so that the channels do not have to be in an array. Should we update the Audio API to the same?
I would need some discussion to have an opinion on that.

The array of pointers does seem more flexible, I agree, and I do not see any drawbacks with it. 
So yes, changing the Audio API seems to make sense.  But that would be a separate PR, I assume.

> But that would be a separate PR, I assume.

Indeed, I'll create an issue for it
